findings.title: Budget stranded post-expiry when schedule expires with no dispatcher inflow; zero-stake gaps feed the stranding
emergencyWithdraw permanently strands forfeited rewards as dead tokens in the contract
setWindowDuration does not recompute rewardRate or windowEnd, violating spec and creating a latent rate-spike MEV surface on next pull
Monotonic-upward invariant combined with integer-floor candidate traps rewardRate below usable levels with no owner recovery path
_applyAsymmetricWindow integer divisions in extend-branch and candidate computation silently under-account small inflows and budget changes
pendingReward view does not simulate dispatcherHook.pull() inflow, understating realized rewards and enabling OTC mispricing
setStakedId can be blocked indefinitely by a single 1-unit staker, front-running or simply refusing to exit
stake / unstake / claim revert when dispatcherHook.pull() reverts, forcing users through emergencyWithdraw and forfeiting rewards
setDispatcherHook does not run _syncBudget before swapping the hook, stranding undrawn mint-debt on the outgoing hook
